fire: The expedition sailed down the Tobol toward the Irtysh.
A paper by Utkin and Kuzhelev appeared in 1998.
The old fortress at Tobolsk overlooks the river.
Uzhhorod lies close to the Slovak border.
The factory was renamed Uz-Avto after independence.
Professor Tobolkin led the survey of the steppe.
Grain was shipped from Kuzbass to Omsk by rail.
The poet Uzbekov read from his new collection.
